processes.name: Check eligibility
steps: Validate session and device
Check account standing and tenure
Load Zelle profile if already enrolled

processes.name: Register token
steps: Send one-time code and verify possession
Capture acceptance of Zelle terms
Register token-to-account link in the network directory

processes.name: Resolve recipient
steps: Look up the token in the network directory
Return enrolled status and registered name
Save recipient to the customer's list

processes.name: Confirm payee and warn
steps: Display the registered name
Show a scam warning for first payment to a new recipient
Log the acknowledgement

processes.name: Check funds and limits
steps: Read available balance
Check daily and 30-day send limits
Screen memo text

processes.name: Authorize payment
steps: Score risk in real time: device, behavior, payee newness, amount
Approve, step up, hold for review, or decline
Create the payment order

processes.name: Execute payment
steps: Debit the sender's account (memo post)
Send the payment instruction to the Zelle network
Receiving bank credits the recipient, usually within minutes
Record the network acknowledgement

processes.name: Settle and reconcile
steps: Interbank settlement runs on a schedule, after the customer sees the money
Post to the general ledger
Reconcile the network report to the ledger and work breaks

processes.name: Notify both sides
steps: Send push and email to the sender
Network tells the receiving bank, which notifies the recipient
Write the activity record

processes.name: Manage payment status
steps: Show status from the payment record
Allow cancel only while unclaimed
Expire unclaimed payments and return funds per network rules

processes.name: Resolve claim
steps: Classify: unauthorized, scam, or sent in error
Unauthorized → Regulation E investigation
Qualifying imposter scam → network recovery rules
Sent in error → recall request to the receiving bank

controls.text: A token belongs to one user at one bank in the network
Rate-limit directory lookups to stop enumeration
New-payee flag passed to risk scoring
Scam warning on first payment to a new recipient
Amount and velocity limits by customer segment
Real-time fraud score inside a decision time budget
Manual review queue for held payments
Irrevocable once accepted; reversal only by recall
Notification is the customer's record of the payment
Cancel only before funds are claimed
Regulation E timelines for unauthorized transfers

moments.frontstage: Status definitions (verbatim): 'Scheduled means that the wire has not started processing yet and you can still cancel it. Pending means that the wire is in process, and you can no longer cancel it. Completed means that your wire has been sent successfully. Failed means that we were unable to send the money to your recipient. We will return the funds to your account. Canceled means that your wire has been canceled and will not be sent. Returned means that your wire was not accepted by your recipient's bank. We will return the funds to your account. Under review means that your wire is undergoing additional verification for your security.' Cutoffs 3:00 pm PT domestic, 2:20 pm PT international, 4:30 pm PT to another Wells Fargo account; 'We may need to contact you to verify the payment, which could delay its delivery.'

journeys.assessment: Observed first-hand on the web (review and confirmation screens not reached). The send flow is compact (recipient → amount with inline limits and a repeat toggle → review) and shows the recipient's registered name before the amount, but the only scam messaging seen is a static banner on every visit. 'Family controls' for teen access is a control no public page describes; 'Blocked contacts' and 'Manage payment profiles' give publicly documented capabilities a management surface. The weak point is exception handling: a completed payment offers only 'Block', no Zelle item was offered in the online dispute picker on this profile, and scam intake is a phone number.

catalog.description: P2P and small-business send/request/split between U.S. bank accounts using a U.S. mobile number, email or Zelle® tag. No fee in the app or Online Banking. Embedded in the Mobile Banking app and Online Banking; also voice/text-initiated via Erica.

sub_products.name: Send money with Zelle® (Pay)
sub_products.description: One-time immediate, future-dated ('Choose a payment date') or recurring ('Make payment recurring') payment to an enrolled or not-yet-enrolled recipient by mobile/email/tag or QR code. Erica can initiate.
sub_products.other_flags: recurring_requires_60_days_enrollment: Yes; recurring_not_available_to_unenrolled_recipient: Yes; recipient_name_check_field: Enrolled with Zelle® as; erica_initiation: Yes; temporary_higher_limit_to_select_recipients_shown_in_pay_flow: Yes; recipient_list_badges: purple Z = Zelle recipient; Bank of America logo = BofA account recipient (sent as internal transfer, not Zelle); scheduled_states: Scheduled → Processing (on payment date) → History; statement_descriptors: 'Zelle® Scheduled payment' / 'Zelle® Recurring payment'; edit_single_payment_in_series: No; cancel_single_payment_in_series: Yes; block_or_cancel_notice_by_email: Yes; web_send_money_tab: Send money with Zelle® page > Send Money tab
sub_products.notes: Immediate payments cannot be edited/cancelled; scheduled/recurring editable until 11:59 p.m. ET day before.

capability_detail.step-up-auth: Mobile: one-time authorization code (SMS/email) may be required when adding a recipient and again when paying a new recipient. Web (Online Banking): one-time authorization code PLUS Debit card PIN at both points ('Enter the one-time authorization code and your Debit card PIN to verify'). USB security key (FIDO-2) is the alternative to SMS codes and also gates adding transfer recipients.

sub_products.name: Request money with Zelle® / Split
sub_products.description: Request from one enrolled Zelle user or split a total among up to 10 recipients ('Add Recipient'); requests expire after 14 days. Mobile app only.
sub_products.other_flags: split_max_recipients: 10; include_own_portion_option: Yes; per_recipient_amount_editable: Yes; request_expiry_days: 14; request_to_unenrolled_mobile: No; request_to_unenrolled_email: Yes; activity_sections: Payment Activity > Action Needed (outstanding) / History (expired, completed, canceled); mobile_only: Yes

sub_products.name: Receive money with Zelle® (enrollment of mobile/email; My QR Code)

sub_products.notes: Up to 5 U.S. mobile numbers/email addresses (small business: numbers, emails and Zelle tags in combination) each linkable to a different deposit account; change linked account any time in Zelle settings; alerts routed per Settings > Contact Info (mobile) or Accounts > Alerts (web). Web enrollment demo: Pay & Transfer > Zelle® > Settings tab > 'Add mobile number or email' > choose Deposit account > 'Send Code' > 'Enter Authorization Code' > 'You're all set up'. Eligible numbers: authenticated U.S./territory mobiles only (no VoIP, landline, Google Voice, 1-800, international). Codes sent from onlinebanking@ealerts.bankofamerica.com or short codes 739-81 / 992-17.

sub_products.name: Zelle® for your business (tags, Scan to Pay / My QR code, accept payments)

sub_products.name: Telephone Automated Bill Payment Service / CitiPhone bill pay
sub_products.description: Bill payments via IVR or a CitiPhone representative at no fee; counts as a qualifying bill payment for fee waivers.

sub_products.name: Bill payment alerts and payee spending report
sub_products.description: Account alerts for payments due, low balance, cleared deposits; per-payee spending report.

catalog.name: Transfers between linked Citibank accounts (Internal Transfers)
catalog.ui_position: Citi Online: 'Transfer Between Your Accounts' page (linked Citi accounts and, per the IIT page, the new home for linked external accounts and scheduled transfers); Citi Mobile App transfers; Proprietary Citibank ATM 'Transfer' option; CitiPhone. Intra Citi Transfers (to another U.S. Citibank customer) sit under Services > MOVE YOUR MONEY > Transfers > 'Wire or Intra Citi Transfers' and are fee-free since November 8, 2025. CBOL: Main Menu > Transfers and Payments > Transfer Between Accounts.
catalog.description: Move funds between linked Citibank checking, savings and credit accounts via Citi Online, Citi Mobile, CitiPhone Banking, Proprietary Citibank ATMs or Network ATMs; automatic weekly / every-other-week / monthly transfers; 'Intra Citi Transfer' to another U.S. Citibank customer by routing/account number (consumer).

sub_products.name: One-time internal transfer
sub_products.description: Immediate transfer between linked accounts; 10:30 PM ET digital cutoff for same-business-day posting.

sub_products.name: Automatic (recurring) transfers
sub_products.description: Weekly, every-other-week or monthly transfers between linked checking and savings (e.g., sweep savings interest to checking); automatic payments to credit accounts.
sub_products.notes: Business manual: cancel in branch/phone/writing at least 3 Business Days before the transfer (S013).

sub_products.name: Intra Citi Transfer (to another U.S. Citibank customer)
sub_products.description: Consumer-only transfer from a U.S. consumer account to another U.S. Citibank customer's account using Citibank routing numbers; settled internally; 60-day error window.
sub_products.notes: Settled on Citi's books when the other account uses a listed Citibank routing number. Fees: Amendment effective November 8, 2025 waives all Intra Citi Transfer fees (incoming; outgoing online; outgoing via branch/banker) for every tier (previously $25 Standard / $17.50 Citi Priority online, $35 other channels). Requested online under 'Wire or Intra Citi Transfers' (same payee flow as wires).

catalog.name: Inter-Institution Transfer (IIT) Service ('Transfer funds to other banks')
catalog.former_names: Inter Institution Transfer Service
catalog.ui_position: Citi.com: Services > MOVE YOUR MONEY > Transfers > Inter Institution Transfers (page title 'Transfer funds to other banks'; CTA 'Sign on and Make a Transfer' → post-login route JRSMENU_Transfers). Citi Online: Payments Dashboard > 'Manage Bills & Payees' > 'External Accounts' tab > 'Add an External Account' (in the 'For Transfers' section); transfers are made on the 'Transfer Between Your Accounts' page (toggle 'Set Up a Recurring Transfer'); scheduled/recurring transfers are viewed and cancelled on the 'View/Manage Activity' page ('Cancel' link in the Actions column). Also available in the Citi Mobile App (CDAA 8.2.5).
catalog.description: Free link-and-transfer service (one-time or recurring; weekly, biweekly or monthly) between a Citibank checking, savings or money market account and a checking, savings, money market or investment account the customer owns at another U.S. financial institution or credit union that accepts ACH (no third-party transfers; IRAs, custodial/trust, business accounts and loans excluded); set up with the external account number and ABA number, 'subject to verification by Citibank'; executed generally via ACH (same-day ACH if requested before 12:30 PM ET on a business day, otherwise next business day), estimated deposit date shown at review; per-transfer/aggregate limits by tenure (Tenured = Citi consumer accounts open ≥91 days: inbound $100,000/day and /30 days, outbound $25,000/day and $50,000/30 days; Untenured: $10,000/day, $15,000/30 days); cancel by 9:30 PM ET the day before (cancelling one of a series cancels the series). The IIT page recommends migrating linked external accounts and scheduled instructions to the new Citi 'Transfer Between Your Accounts' service.

sub_products.name: Link an external account
sub_products.description: Add and verify an account you own at another U.S. institution (verification method - micro-deposits vs. instant - not evidenced).
sub_products.notes: Link via Citi Online: Manage Bills & Payees > External Accounts tab > 'Add an External Account' (For Transfers section) with the external account number and ABA number; 'External accounts are subject to verification by Citibank' (method — micro-deposits vs. instant — still not disclosed; the IIT Terms and Conditions modal on the product page renders empty). Joint Citi accounts: both users can transfer only if both co-signed the external account. Remove via Manage Bills & Payees > 'Delete'. The product page recommends adding existing linked external accounts and scheduled instructions to the new 'Transfer Between Your Accounts' service.

sub_products.name: Outbound transfer to external account
sub_products.description: Push funds from Citibank to a verified external account; one-time or series.
sub_products.notes: Transfer Between Your Accounts page; recurring toggle (weekly/biweekly/monthly); same-day ACH before 12:30 PM ET; outbound availability subject to the external bank; limits Tenured $25,000/day, $50,000/30 days; Untenured $10,000/day, $15,000/30 days; cancel by 9:30 PM ET the day before on View/Manage Activity (no Cancel link = not cancellable; cancelling one recurring transfer cancels all future ones).

sub_products.name: Inbound transfer from external account
sub_products.description: Pull funds from a verified external account into Citibank; provisional until ACH final settlement.
sub_products.notes: Inbound limits Tenured $100,000/day and /30 days; Untenured $10,000/day, $15,000/30 days; ACH credits are provisional until final payment; inbound external ACH transfers count toward 'Direct Deposits or other qualifying transactions' for the fee waiver.

sub_products.name: Stop payment on pre-authorized / one-time ACH debits
sub_products.description: Consumer can stop a recurring pre-authorized transfer (3 Business Days' notice) or a one-time future-dated ACH debit (by 11:59 PM ET the day before) via Citi Online or phone.

sub_products.name: Direct Deposit set-up with payer search (Enhanced Direct Deposit enrollment)
sub_products.description: In-app/online flow to route payroll, pension or government ACH credits to a Citi checking account: 'Search and select your payer from the list / Add accounts where you will deposit funds / Review and confirm your request' ('Get Started' routes to login nextRoute=directdeposit, i.e. online.citi.com/US/nga/directdeposit). Qualifying 'Direct Deposits or other qualifying transactions' of $250+/month ($1,000+ for Regular Checking from 01/01/2027) waive the Monthly Service Fee; Zelle incoming, external ACH credits and PayPal/Venmo ACH count; wires, MCD, branch/ATM and non-ACH instant transfers do not.
sub_products.notes: Vendor behind payer search not identified. Captured from the Enhanced Direct Deposit page; the flow itself sits behind sign-on.

catalog.name: Wire Transfers (Citi Online / Citi Mobile App 'Immediate Funds Transfers')

Citi Online: Payments Dashboard > 'Manage Payees and Bills' > 'People' tab > 'Add a New Payee/Recipient' (person vs business; country-specific fields prompted) → send; 'All Transfer Activity' filtered to 'Wires & Transfers' with a 'Scheduled' tab (View to edit / Cancel). Citi Mobile App supports self-service wires ('Online' fee tier). CBOL: Main Menu > Transfers and Payments > Set up a Wire Transfer (Domestic, Foreign or Models) / Domestic Wire (USA Destination) / Express Domestic Wires.
catalog.description: Domestic (Fedwire/CHIPS) and international wires initiated digitally in Citi Online or the Citi Mobile App (consumer and small business), at a branch, or through CitiBusiness Online for business. International wires may be sent in USD or a foreign currency at Citi's rate (commission built in). Consumer international wires are regulated Remittance Transfers with a 30-minute cancellation window and 180-day error window.

sub_products.name: Domestic wire (online)
sub_products.description: USD wire to a U.S. beneficiary bank that is a Federal Reserve member/correspondent or CHIPS member; email notice if rejected; cancel only before execution.
sub_products.notes: Online (self-service via Citi Online or Citi Mobile) domestic wire fee $25 Standard / $17.50 Citi Priority / waived Citigold+ in the Nov 2025 fee chart; amendment effective August 1, 2026 raises it to $30 Standard / $25 Citi Priority ('Fee for Domestic Funds Transfer'). Branch/banker-assisted domestic wire $35 (waived CPC); no maximum amount at a branch. Online: future-dated one-time and recurring domestic wires; save and reuse wires; cutoff 6:45 PM ET. Cancel same-day wires only before execution; future-dated/recurring until the day before via All Transfer Activity > Wires & Transfers > Scheduled > Cancel. Rejections notified at request time or as soon as determined.

sub_products.name: International wire in USD (online)
sub_products.description: USD wire to a foreign beneficiary; small-business accounts may schedule or set recurring future-dated USD international wires.
sub_products.notes: Online international USD wire fee $35 Standard / $25 Citi Priority (Nov 2025 chart); amendment effective August 1, 2026 raises it to $40 / $35; waived for Citigold and Citigold Private Client. Foreign-currency online wires are fee-free for all tiers. Cutoff 6:00 PM ET. Small-business accounts may schedule/recur USD international wires.

sub_products.name: International wire in foreign currency / Remittance Transfer (consumer)
sub_products.description: Consumer wire to a foreign beneficiary for personal purposes; Reg E remittance disclosures at initiation; FX rate with commission shown; 30-minute cancellation; 180-day error window.
sub_products.other_flags: reg_e_remittance: Yes; cancel_within_30_minutes: Yes; currency_choice_local_or_usd: Yes; iban_bic_required_where_applicable: Yes
sub_products.notes: Remittance Transfer: cancel/amend within 30 minutes for a full refund unless funds already picked up/deposited — online by navigating to the specific transaction in the Activity Page, or by phone 1-888-606-9716; refund within 3 business days. Errors within 180 days; Citi decides within 90 days; remedy choice credit or resend. IBAN required for Europe, CLABE for Mexico; country-specific fields (e.g., reason for payment) are prompted when the payee is added.

sub_products.name: Branch-initiated wire
sub_products.description: Domestic or international wire requested with a banker; callback may apply above a dollar threshold; cutoff times available at branches.

sub_products.name: Incoming wires
sub_products.description: Credit to account; no separate credit advice; notice deemed given on statement; status visible via Citi Mobile App / Citi Online / phone.
sub_products.notes: Wires count as New-to-Citibank Funds (S028).

catalog.name: Citibank Global Transfer Service (Citi Global Transfers)

No fee to send or receive; $1 minimum. Outgoing limits (Standard / Citi Priority / Citigold / Citigold Private Client): daily $50,000 / $75,000 / $100,000 / $100,000 on Citi Online and on Citi Mobile; weekly $50,000 / $100,000 / $150,000 / $500,000; first-time transfers subject to lower limits; destination countries may impose lower limits and may change. International transfers are Remittance Transfers (30-minute cancellation; cancel via 1-866-515-1725, Citi Online or the Citi Mobile App; refund within 3 business days).

sub_products.name: Global Transfer to a U.S. Citibank customer
sub_products.description: Immediate USD credit to another Citibank U.S. customer; no fee; $1 minimum.

sub_products.name: Global Transfer to a Citibank account in select markets (international)
sub_products.description: Cross-border transfer credited in recipient currency; FX commission in rate; countries subject to change; Remittance Transfer rules (30-minute cancel, 180-day errors).
sub_products.notes: Recipient set-up: Quick Link 'Add a CGT Payee' > Destination / Beneficiary Name / Beneficiary Nickname / Beneficiary Citibank Account # > verify > printable confirmation. Funds move 'once your transfer is reviewed'. First-time transfers subject to lower limits; destination countries may impose lower limits. Cancel (Remittance Transfer, 30 minutes): 1-866-515-1725 or sign into Citi Online / Citi Mobile App; refund within 3 business days. Checking Plus can fund a transfer; Safety Check does not apply to transfers. Savings/money market sources allow a limited number of transfers per statement period.

sub_products.name: Receive a Global Transfer from a U.S. Citibank customer
sub_products.description: Inbound CGT credit; not counted as Enhanced Direct Deposit or New-to-Citibank Funds.

catalog.name: Wire Transfers (consumer / small business)

Incoming: routing 042000314, SWIFT FTBCUS3C, no IBAN.

sub_products.notes: Security Procedures (Oct 2025): online wires require User ID + password + token passcode; optional Dual Transaction Approval (originate vs release on separate devices) and Approval Workflows with unlimited approvers. Standing-order and drawdown wires set up by signed service form are not re-verified per wire. Manual (email/in-person) wires need an Outgoing Wire Transfer Request Agreement, signature verification, then call-back to a secondary individual and/or in-/out-of-wallet questions; failure = order deemed canceled; Dual Control Security Waiver required to opt out. Transaction monitoring may halt/delay a wire pending confirmation.

sub_products.name: Instant Payments — RTP send and receive (Request for Payment)

sub_products.notes: DSA wire addendum (12/11/2025) section 1 'Protect Yourself Against Wire Scams' is the published scam text: 'Only wire money to people you know or recipients you have verified… once the wire is sent, you may not be able to recover your money. Know the signs of a scam. The requestor: Sends you wire instructions via email (ex. loan closing – always verify details by phone) • Contacts you unexpectedly • Claims there is an emergency • Pressures you into paying immediately • Only accepts payments via wire, gift cards, or crypto currency • Tells you to keep it secret or instructs you how to answer questions at the bank • Makes an offer… too good to be true • Asks for your personal information' plus six named scam types. Processing same Business Day if received and security procedures completed before 'the cutoff times we establish' (consumer cutoff not published); all requests subject to internal review (may contact customer, hold/subtract funds); once processing has begun no cancel/modify, but customer may ask Chase to attempt a return (recipient bank may agree; likely not full amount). Status updated on the Wire Payment activity page; email/secure message, call or SMS may follow; status reflects Chase processing only. Returned-wire reasons: wrong account number, missing country-specific info (e.g., statement of payment purpose), conflicting 'Message to recipient bank' field, name mismatch; returns may be net of fees/FX.

catalog.description: Self-service domestic wires and international wires (180+ countries, USD or 20+ foreign currencies) from any personal PNC checking or savings account in Online Banking, the PNC Mobile app, or a branch, governed by the Self-Service Wire and Money Transfer Agreement (eff. June 3, 2025). First use requires accepting terms; each payment order is authenticated with at least one of: one-time passcode to the phone on file, debit card information, PIN/other PII, or a callback. Payment orders are processed the day received during business hours 8:30 a.m.-6:00 p.m. ET on business days (or on the requested later date). PNC does not send written advice, receipts or confirmations for domestic/business wires unless required by law; customers have no absolute right to cancel or amend after receipt (PNC makes a reasonable, no-liability effort before processing). Consumer international transfers get a pre-payment disclosure and receipt with a 'Date Available', a 30-minute cancellation right, and a 180-day error-notice window (Reg E). Incoming: routing 043000096 / SWIFT PNCCUS33.

catalog.description: Treasury Management disbursement and receivables suite documented in public Service Schedules (tmdocuments.html): Integrated/Consolidated Payables (check, card, ACH, AFT, wire); Intelligent Routing (customer-ranked Payment Types: Instant Payments, Same Day ACH, ACH, Wire; returned Instant Payments can be rerouted if the reroute option is enabled; PPD/CCD only; weekend/holiday future-dated items sent as Instant Payment shortly after midnight); ePayments (B2C disbursement via PINACLE, API or Direct File Transmission - payee is notified by email/text and chooses ACH, Instant Payment, check, debit card, Zelle, Direct to Debit (Visa), or PayPal/Venmo on a white-labeled portal; Payee Approver and expiration controls; expired payments fall back to a PNC-printed check); Direct to Debit Card (push-to-card, BAI 699); Zelle Disbursements (settle as ACH, status 'Delivered'); FedNow and RTP instant payments; Verification Services (Early Warning bank-account verification); API catalog incl. Payments (Wire/ACH/RTP/Direct to Debit with Intelligent Routing), ePayments (initiate/status/cancel), Request For Payment, Webhooks and Zelle Lookup; Lockbox, EDI, PayerExpress, Automated Cash Application, Cash Logistics.

sub_products.name: Integrated Payables (consolidated payment file: check, card, ACH, wire)
Intelligent Routing (RTP / wire / Same Day ACH / next-day ACH auto-selection)
sub_products.description: Customer ranks Payment Preferences across four Payment Types - Instant Payments, Same Day ACH, ACH, Wire Transfer/Funds Transfer - and PNC selects the type per payment (subject to limits, risk parameters, cutoffs and network rules). Returned Instant Payments can be rerouted to the next type only if the return reason is reroute-eligible and the client subscribed to reroute at setup; otherwise rejected and must be resubmitted. Returned ACH and cancelled/rejected wires are never reprocessed. Only PPD/CCD ACH allowed. Future-dated items go ACH if the date is a business day, otherwise as an Instant Payment sent shortly after midnight of the future date. Modification/cancel may be impossible once processing starts. Acknowledgement and confirmation files available.

sub_products.name: ePayments (consumer disbursement by email/mobile; payee chooses method)
sub_products.description: Business-to-consumer disbursement initiated through PINACLE, API ('ePayments: initiate, check status, or cancel payments to consumers') or Direct File Transmission using the payee's email/mobile ('Alias Information'). PNC notifies the Recipient of a Pending Payment by email and/or text (client-enabled Text Platform can also deliver OTPs); the Recipient accepts by the Expiration Date on a white-labeled portal (client supplies its own Terms/Privacy; no PNC branding; sample consent copy references the 'Pay Choice' brand) and chooses a Permissible Payment Method: ACH, Instant Payment, check, debit card, Zelle, Direct to Debit (Visa), PayPal/Venmo. Registered Recipients can auto-accept future/recurring payments. An optional Payee Approver (not the Recipient) must approve initiation. Settlement account is charged only after acceptance; expired payments are handled per client preference (default: PNC-printed check). Statuses in the Status file / PINACLE ePayments module: Released (ACH, check), Delivered (Instant Payments, Zelle, Direct to Debit Card, PayPal/Venmo), Failed (ACH return - no check fallback), Expired. Payee reminder texts come from short code 26489.
sub_products.notes: Resolved: dedicated product page does not exist; the ePayments Service schedule (Version April 2026) and reconciliation deck document it. PayPal/Venmo added as a payee-choice method.

sub_products.name: Direct to Debit Card (push-to-card disbursements)
sub_products.description: Push-to-card disbursement to a payee's debit card, listed as 'Direct to Debit (Visa®)' among ePayments Permissible Payment Methods and as 'Direct to Debit payments' in the Payments API (Wire, ACH, RTP, Direct to Debit with Intelligent Routing). Recipient supplies a debit card number on the ePayments portal; final status 'Delivered'; posts in Information Reporting/BAI2 as Miscellaneous Debits (code 699) with the Trace ID after 'DTDC Payer Name'. The standalone Direct to Debit Card Service schedule PDF is image-only (not readable).
sub_products.notes: Runs on Visa Direct (PNC-Visa collaboration renewed Oct 29 2025); available via API and the ePayments platform.

The developer portal's Zelle Lookup API tells a client whether an alias is registered and eligible before paying.

PNC's release and Intelligent Routing schedule treat 'Instant Payments' as an outbound disbursement type (INFERRED send). The developer API catalog (Nov 2026) still names RTP but not FedNow. catalog.name: PNC Alerts (Account Alerts, Security Alerts, Intelligent Alerts, fraud-alert texts)

catalog.description: Push, email and text alerts: Account Alerts (balances, direct deposit arrival, overdraft, card spending - customer-selected) and Security Alerts (account-access changes, contact-information changes, suspicious activity - automatically on to the primary email and cannot be turned off there; text/push opt-in). Zelle payments, requests and security notifications; also Text Banking), 762273 (card activity), 76200/76201/32858 (OTP), 94387/76205 (fraud-prevention transaction confirmation), 90742 (online-purchase OTP), 762729 (adding a card to a wallet). Replying STOP to 762265 stops Text Banking, Zelle and Alerts texts together. Since app 4.63 (Apr 2026) push notifications can be turned on for all available alerts. Low Cash Mode Intelligent Alerts; Bill Pay email reminders.

sub_products.name: Account & security alerts
sub_products.description: Account Alerts (customer-selected: balances, direct deposit arrival, overdraft, card transactions) and Security Alerts (auto-on; account-access changes, contact changes, suspicious activity). Managed in Mobile (Profile & Settings > Alerts tile > Security Alerts / Account Alerts > alert > Push Notifications / Email / Text > Save) or Online Banking (profile icon > Alerts and Communication > Alert Management tab > toggle or 'Edit Delivery and Alert options'); mobile changes sync to web; push can only be managed in mobile; STOP opts out of texts (one confirmation message). Push notifications for 'all available PNC alerts' enabled from app 4.63 (Apr 2026).

Zelle and Alerts), ESP/ENG (language preference). No money-movement commands. Enrollment: Online Banking profile > Alerts and Communications > Text Banking > Manage Your Phone Numbers / Manage Text Banking Settings; Mobile: Profile & Settings > Phone numbers > Add Phone > OTP verification. One mobile number per Online Banking profile. Not available for all accounts.

sub_products.other_flags: api_rail_routing: RTP | FEDNOW | RTP_and_FEDNOW (verify-routing-number endpoint); api_statuses: RECEIVED; PROCESSING; COMPLETED; REJECTED; api_reject_codes: IN01; IN02; MM20; MM21; NARR; request_for_payment_api: not in public v1 reference; idempotency_key_header: Yes
sub_products.notes: Confirmed by the public Instant Payments API v1 reference: 'Send a payment from your Wells Fargo account to another U.S. based bank account via Instant Payments'; GET /instant-payments/v1/routing-numbers/verify/{rtn}?amount= returns instant_payments_enabled, participant_available, payment_rail (RTP | FEDNOW | RTP_and_FEDNOW | INACTIVE), participant_name, supported_messages (CRDT Credit Transfer); POST /credit-transfers (end_to_end_id visible to recipient, duplicate_check lookback days, debtor/creditor/ultimate_debtor, USD only, 18-second timeout); GET /credit-transfers/{uetr} and POST /search return status RECEIVED | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | REJECTED with reason codes IN01, IN02, MM20, MM21, NARR (free text from receiving bank). Commercial hub: 'Our API channel offers intelligent routing — once the payment is initiated, it is sent through the most appropriate rail — RTP® and FedNow®.' No Request for Payment resource in the public v1 reference.

sub_products.name: Consolidated payables (Integrated Payables)

sub_products.name: Mobile deposit (multi-check) and deposit approvals

sub_products.name: Tokenized deposits (on-chain 24/7/365 settlement; USD→GBP pilot)
sub_products.description: 'A blockchain-based representation of commercial bank money that when fully deployed will enable Wells Fargo's corporate and commercial clients to move, program, and settle funds 24/7/365 — without leaving the regulated, insured banking system.' Rolls out fall 2026 for select clients with USD→GBP exchange; expands through 2027 to more clients, countries and currencies. Integrated into the existing offering: payments are automatically routed through tokenized deposits 'when they can improve speed, timing, and flexibility'. Future: always-on settlement between accounts/subsidiaries/counterparties, smart-contract conditional payments, same deposit-insurance eligibility.
sub_products.other_flags: status: pilot (fall 2026); currencies: USD→GBP initially; programmable_payments: Yes; proprietary_blockchain: Yes
sub_products.notes: Announcement-level evidence only; client UI/entitlement flow not published.

sub_products.name: Treasury Management Services for Business Banking (via Vantage)
sub_products.description: Small businesses can enroll in Treasury Management Services delivered through Wells Fargo Vantage and the Vantage app: same-day or future-dated domestic/cross-border wires with approve/reject on smartphone; ACH payments (prepaid credit) for payroll, tax and vendor payments; Desktop Deposit® (scanner) and Vantage mobile deposit; ACH fraud filter pay/return decisions; dual custody, user transaction limits and online user administration; ACH NOC/returns report.
sub_products.other_flags: enrollment_required: Yes; desktop_deposit_rdc: Yes; ach_fraud_filter: Yes
sub_products.notes: Corrects the chapter view that Vantage/approval workflows are unavailable to small business.

observations.text: Single 'Pay & Transfer' hub spanning Zelle, Pay Bills, Transfer, Wire/ACH with consistent Activity view and demos for every rail [S001,S009,S014,S015]

Deepest virtual-assistant money movement among large banks: Erica can send/request Zelle, make recurring transfers, add payees, pay/cancel bills, send wires and check wire status, manage Zelle tags [S017,S003,S005,S020]

Layered Zelle controls: new-recipient OTP, 'You're authorizing a payment to someone new' interstitial, mandatory disclaimer acknowledgement, 60-day tenure gate on recurring, tenure-based limits, 'Pending review' holds, and explicit imposter-scam reimbursement language [S014,S002,S013]
No-fee foreign-currency international wires in 140+ currencies with a guided mobile flow and Reg E remittance cancel/refund rights [S005,S016]

Full, public explanation of Zelle payment states (Pending acceptance / Pending review / Paid; Scheduled → Processing → History) with Message Center guidance and email notices when the bank blocks or cancels a payment [S901,S013]
Parity web demos for Zelle send/receive exist (16-step and 8-step), with stronger web step-up (one-time code + debit card PIN) than mobile [S911,S912]
Deposit-hold disclosure is in-flow: mobile deposit confirmation screen, ATM screen/receipt and branch receipt all state the hold; later holds trigger an email alert [S903]
Fraud/scam claims are trackable in-app (Inbox > Status Tracker > View More Details) for consumer accounts [S915]
Scale: 25M active Zelle users, 1.8B transactions / $556B in 2025; small-business Zelle 200M payments / $126B; CashPro mobile approvals $1.2T [S921]

Commercial leadership: TCH co-owner, one of the first to enable $10M RTP, Recipient Select/Global Digital Disbursements with Zelle/Venmo/PayPal/Interac/Pay to Card, 100+ CashPro APIs, Coalition Greenwich No. 1 digital channels four years running [S025,S052,S053,S071,S049]
Senate PSI: BofA reimbursed 24% of Zelle scam disputes in 2023, an 'outlier' vs 2% (Chase) and 4% (Wells Fargo); BofA testified it reimbursed imposter scams before the 2023 network rule [S961][S962].
Bank-stated pre-send controls: new-recipient 'speed bump', high-risk transfers cancelled unless customer affirmatively confirms [S962].
No FedNow participation as of late 2025 (one of two top-8 holdouts) [S030,S031]
Consumer external-transfer (ACH) base limits are low ($1,000 per transaction) and no Same Day ACH option; external transfers are buried under the 'Wire/ACH' label [S013,S016]
Zelle request/split and QR are mobile-only; web lacks request/split [S002]
Secured Transfer requires debit card number + PIN + mobile OTP (or USB key) – a hard dependency for wires/ACH [S005,S015,S016]

No documented dual-approval/dual-control for small business payments in Business Advantage 360; SMB limited to $5,000 ACH/wire base limits; legacy Direct Payments and Payments & Invoicing closed [S021,S013]
Bill Pay cancellation window (5 p.m. ET three business days before delivery) is restrictive; AutoPay requires eBills [S013,S010]
Consumer RTP 'Request for Payment' exists only in legal terms with no visible UI/marketing [S013]
Business account fraud claims are not viewable in the in-app Status Tracker [S915]
Remote Deposit Online supports a single User ID (sub-user deposits under the owner's ID) and does not verify funds at capture [S924]
No self-service cancel for a submitted domestic wire is documented; only Remittance Transfers have the 30-minute cancel [S005,S916]
No Zelle accounting-software integration for small business ('does not currently integrate directly with accounting software') [S901]

Payment-purpose prompts / recipient-specific risk warnings in the 2025–26 Zelle flow are not described anywhere public; only the generic 'authorizing a payment to someone new' pop-up and static scam block are documented [S911,S002]

Zelle scam intake runs through Online Banking or phone (via the Security Center page). No mobile in-app scam-report path is documented, and reimbursement criteria remain 'qualifying imposter scams' [S037,S901,S915]

Mobile deposit exceptions (e.g., potential fraud, insufficient funds on the check) are communicated by postal letter asking the customer to bring the check to a financial center. Holds are shown on the confirmation screen or by email alert [S006,S903]

No public documentation of dual approval or per-user limits for Business Advantage 360 core payments. The sub-user demo shows only view/transact toggles and Full/Limited Bill Pay access. An approval role existed only in the legacy Payments and Invoicing (Bill.com) service, closed to new enrollment [S906,S021] (INFERRED)
PSI: BofA policy treats a review of its own records as sufficient to deny a Zelle claim when funds went to an account outside BofA [S961].
EWS assessed BofA a $30,000 network noncompliance fee in Sept 2023 (PSI p. 7) [S961].
CFPB complaint (Dec 2024; allegation, dismissed Mar 2025) attributed ~$290M of losses across ~210,000 BofA customers [S963].
Warren 2022 (2021–H1 2022): BofA refunded about 45% of the dollar value of reported unauthorized Zelle transfers ($56.1M of $125M) [S966].
