Observed (web session): Wire Money carries a rail-specific wire-scam banner and a 'Compare options' explainer (Zelle vs Wires; ExpressSend vs Wires) covering fees, speed, cash-to-person and enrollment channel, plus a pre-wire FX 'Estimate' tool and a 3-step recipient wizard with ABA lookup [S990].

Bank-stated (PSI testimony 2024): 'multiple warnings and authentication steps each time customers send money with Zelle', post-send scam interdiction, >1 million risky transactions blocked in 2023, >99.9% of Zelle transfers without a claim [S962].
Scam/fraud support is fragmented across at least four phone numbers (1-800-869-3557, 1-800-956-4442, 1-866-867-5568, 1-800-225-5935) with different scopes.

External (bank-to-bank) transfers are slow by default (2/3 business days) with micro-deposit verification (1–3 days); next-day/higher-limit is discretionary; no instant account verification or push-to-card instant transfer product.
No consumer-initiated RTP/FedNow send outside RfP-driven Bill Pay; no consumer-facing marketing of instant rails at all; inbound instant credits' labeling undocumented.

Direct Pay is desktop-only, next-business-day only (no Same Day ACH documented), carries a $10/month fee, and publishes its cancel/change cutoff and rejected-payment notice only in the Direct Pay Agreement (S970); ACH-return handling and Same Day ACH remain unpublished.

Many key pages (Control Tower, Fargo FAQs, Zelle-scams page, commercial instant-payments pages, developer portal) were unreachable or JS-only, suggesting information-architecture decay around Control Tower branding.

'Control Tower' branding has been fully retired without a replacement explainer: every landing/FAQ URL 404s and site search returns nothing; the capability survives only as 'Card Settings' bullet copy in the App Store listing [S935][S922].

Commercial Request for Payment is absent from the public Instant Payments API v1 (credit transfers only), and the dedicated treasury-management instant-payments pages that once existed now 404 [S916][S912].

Direct Pay and Bill Pay public FAQs still omit cancel/edit of scheduled payments and return handling (Bill Pay defers to post-sign-on Help); external-account linking offers no instant verification (1–3 business days) [S931][S910][S930].

Small businesses get approval workflows only via Direct Pay or by enrolling in Vantage Treasury Management (dual custody, wire approve/reject, ACH fraud filter); in default Business Online, Zelle, Business Bill Pay and wires show no documented dual-approval option (INFERRED from OAA delegate terms) [S951][S040].

ExpressSend is migrating to an app-only service (in-app since Jun 29, 2026); legacy branch/online agreements persist, but accepting mobile terms removes branch/web/phone access; neither track supports recurring or future-dated transfers [S908][S909][S009].
Digital Wires is available online and in the app (comparison chart), but published how-to steps cover only Wells Fargo Online; fee messaging inconsistent ($30 flat vs $0–$30) [S009][S906][S907].

No dynamic scam interstitial or payment-purpose prompt is documented on public pages; Wells Fargo says (press, Jan 2026) it alerts customers to double-check recipients, nature unverified; the Zelle-specific scam page now 404s and the hub routes to a generic online-payment-scams page [S902][S934][S955].

Observed (web session): exception handling stays off-channel — the Zelle payment detail screen offers only 'Block'; on the observed profile the 'Track Claims > Dispute a charge' picker listed only debit-card purchases (whether non-card items are excluded is unconfirmed); 'Report Phish & Email Scams' links out to a public education page; ACH stops are online but recurring debit-card stops and check ranges are phone-only [S990].

Observed (web session): direct-deposit setup is a prefilled PDF ('Create Form') rather than an embedded payroll-login switch (Bank of America, TD, Fifth Third and Truist offer one; PNC's Quick Switch Center generates switch letters), and the web 'Manage Alerts' page offers only balance, Direct Deposit and Returned Deposited Item alerts for checking accounts — no transfer-sent/received or Zelle alert options on the web (app catalogue not observed) [S990].

Observed (web session): external-account linking is keyed routing/account entry with an ownership attestation; enabling transfers is quoted as 'may take 2-3 business days' of additional security measures, with no aggregator option; a 'Set up for transfers' upgrade on an already-verified payments-only account executed with a single click and no confirmation step [S990].

Observed (web session): Account Access Manager lets a consumer add 'guest users' with view-only online access only; there is no delegated payment initiation or approval for consumer profiles (delegation is a Business Online / Vantage construct) [S990].
Senate PSI (July 2024): WF reimbursed 1 of 10,271 Zelle scam disputes in 2019, 0 of 25,061 in 2020, 4% in 2023; scams were not tracked separately until 2023 (filed under 'non-fraud') [S961].
PSI: WF may reject disputes based on 'data found by utilizing internal systems'; EWS charged WF a $25,000 network noncompliance fee in Oct 2022 [S961].
CFPB complaint (Dec 2024; allegation, dismissed with prejudice Mar 2025): ~280,000 WF customers, ~$220M alleged Zelle fraud losses [S963].
Warren 2022: WF provided 'only incomplete and confidential data' on Zelle fraud despite CEO commitment [S966].
Unlike Chase, no WF social-media-origin Zelle block is cited in the July 2025 congressional letter, which asked WF for social-media scam data and reimbursement policies [S967].
ExpressSend cash-pickup remittance network.
Control Tower (2018) heritage: recurring-payment/digital-footprint view with card on/off, now surfaced as 'view recurring payments' in Card Settings.
Vantage: next-gen commercial platform with persona-driven UX, mobile token replacing hard tokens, and a cross-device Tasks hub.
Wells Fargo is an owner bank of Early Warning (Zelle, Paze) and co-founded clearXchange in 2011.
Public Instant Payments API with rail-agnostic routing (RTP/FedNow) and a routing-number reachability check [S916].
Push to Card API for near-real-time disbursements to consumer debit and prepaid cards (commercial) [S917].
ExpressSend Mobile — dedicated in-app remittance to 12 countries with named retail cash-pickup partners (Walmart, Soriana, Bodega Aurrera, Grupo Éxito, M. Lhuillier, Cebuana Lhuillier) [S909][S926].
Tokenized deposits on a proprietary blockchain for commercial clients (pilot fall 2026) [S928].
Bill Pay instant payments in response to Request for Payment (RTP or another instant network), not excluded from the Payment Guarantee [S040][S011].
Fargo scale (>1B interactions; >3M Spanish-speaking users) — Zelle initiation by assistant is peer parity with BofA Erica [S927][S953].

Observed (web session): Zelle 'Family controls' lets a parent enable or disable Zelle for a teen account holder — not described on any public Wells Fargo page and absent from every peer inventory built from public sources (peers were not observed logged in). The adjacent 'Blocked contacts' and 'Manage payment profiles' screens manage capabilities the public record already documents [S990].

Observed (web session): online self-service for cashier's checks ($2,000 per check / $6,000 per month, express delivery with signature) and foreign-currency cash orders (minimum $200; over $3,000 branch pickup; branches no longer sell FX cash over the counter for same-day purchase) [S990].
At least one payment platform (Modern Treasury) lists WF 'RTP Payments v1' and 'Instant Payments v1' as partner-bank APIs (THIRD_PARTY status notice, Jan 2025) [S980].
Zelle standalone app retired (April 2025); WF FAQ states as of March 31, 2025 all users must enroll through a participating bank's app.
CFPB sued Early Warning, JPMorgan, Bank of America and Wells Fargo over Zelle fraud handling on Dec 20, 2024; CFPB voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Mar 4, 2025 (court order Mar 5, 2025).
Paze live for consumer debit/credit cards with some cards pre-added; enrollment via Card Settings > Digital Wallet.
Wells Fargo Mobile app refreshed color scheme/sign-on (Jan–Mar 2026) and Card Design Studio for debit cards.
Commercial Treasury Management page now markets 'Instant payments' through an API channel routing across RTP and FedNow.
Sep 14 2026: nationwide launch of ExpressSend Mobile announced (in-app release notes from v26.06.00, Jun 29 2026 — earlier than the Jul 30 date previously recorded) [S926][S922].
Aug 4 2026: tokenized deposits announced for corporate/commercial clients; USD→GBP pilot fall 2026, broader rollout 2027 [S928].
Mar 26 2026: Fargo passes 1 billion interactions; 33 million mobile active users [S927].
Nov 6 2026: Wells Fargo app available for macOS (v26.10.01); Oct 6 2026: Mobile Card Design Studio; Jan–May 2026: refreshed sign-on and app color scheme [S922][S929].

Commercial treasury pages reorganized under Solutions > Global Payments & Liquidity (old /com/treasury-management/ URLs 404); developer portal catalog moved from /apis to /banking/commercial [S912][S914].
Zelle marketing page redesigned (DT1-07302027) with 'Scan. Pay. Done.' QR positioning and recurring rent/utility use case [S903].

Vantage iOS app timeline: deposit PDF confirmations (Jun 2025); Transfers create/edit/cancel (Jul 2025); ACH Fraud Filter multi-item (Nov 2025); Tasks hub (Feb 2026); domestic wire approvals (Mar 2026); all wire approvals (Jul 2026); Positive Pay in Fraud Manager + Wires Status Search (Sep 2026); wire/federal tax/book transfer/drawdown approvals + Cash Accounts (Oct 2026); payments tasks on home screen (Nov 2026) [S923].
Jul 1, 2025: Warren/Waters/Blumenthal letter to WF CEO on social-media Zelle scams (responses due Jul 16, 2025; none published) [S967].
Jul 20, 2026: NY court denied EWS motion to dismiss NY AG suit (WF named only as an EWS owner); discovery underway [S964].
Nacha fraud-monitoring rules Phase 1 (Mar 20, 2026) / Phase 2 (Jun 19, 2026) apply to WF as ODFI and RDFI [S969].
Fargo's confirmation UX when initiating a Zelle send (press/FAQ pages blocked).
Commercial Request for Payment send/receive and instant-payment UI inside Vantage (dedicated pages blocked); exact Gateway API catalog names.
Mobile-app-specific Digital Wires flow (all documentation references Wells Fargo Online).
Fargo's exact confirmation UX for a Zelle send remains unpublished (no Fargo FAQ page exists; product page transcripts cover forecast/spending/bills only) [S901].
Commercial Request for Payment send/receive: not in the public Instant Payments API v1; Vantage service help is behind login [S916][S921].
Mobile-app Digital Wires flow: all published steps reference Wells Fargo Online [S906][S907].
Whether Push to Card or Account Validation APIs are exposed to small business (Business Online) — no evidence; commercial only [S914].
Tokenized deposits: client-facing UI/entitlements and whether routing is opt-in are unpublished [S928].

UNRESOLVED (WF-C013): Is ExpressSend truly the only proprietary consumer remittance/cash-pickup product among the top-4? WF self-claim vs Citi's proprietary global-transfer service; needs peer product check.
UNRESOLVED (WF-C029): Does the WF Zelle flow show a dynamic or risk-based 'double-check the recipient' alert (press quote, Jan 2026) or only static copy? Needs an authenticated in-app capture.
Android (Google Play) dates for Vantage wire-approval releases not re-verified; iOS dates used.
FedNow RTN-level send/receive flags sit behind frbservices.org terms-of-use (not accepted by reviewer); participation confirmed, direction from WF API only.
Whether the online 'Dispute a charge' picker excludes Zelle/ACH/transfer items or the observed profile simply had none to show (only debit-card purchases were listed).

Whether the Zelle web review screen shows a dynamic, risk-tiered scam warning for a first-time recipient (observation stopped before review; only the static landing banner was seen — WF-C029 remains open).
Whether Family controls, Blocked contacts and Manage payment profiles are exposed identically in the mobile app (web observed only).

Session handling: several secure-session menu items (Report Phish & Email Scams, Send with ExpressSend®, Deposit a Check) open public pages in the same tab, and the browser's Back returned to the secure session without re-authentication — to confirm as intended design.
Has WF's 2024-2026 scam reimbursement rate moved from the PSI-reported 4% (2023)? No post-2023 bank-level figure is public [S961].

Direct Pay: handling of ACH returns from the payee's bank (R02/R03/R04) and Same Day ACH availability remain unpublished in the Direct Pay Agreement (Apr 28 2022) and FAQ [S970][S931]; cancel/change cutoff now confirmed (3 p.m. PT on Send On Date).
Android (Google Play) date for the Vantage release enabling mobile wire approval: version v26.10.0.20 found on a mirror with no date [S978]; iOS dates remain the only dated evidence.

Exact Gateway API catalogue names now partly evidenced by a platform partner: 'RTP Payments v1' (legacy RTP-only API) and 'Instant Payments v1' (RTP+FedNow routing) [S980, Jan 2025]; commercial Request for Payment send/receive and Vantage instant-payment UI remain unpublished.

Mobile-app Digital Wires: bank copy now says wires can be sent 'from your smartphone or computer with Wells Fargo Online® Wires' [S982], but no published app menu path or screens; the consumer wires page lists only the Wells Fargo Online steps (Sign on > Transfer & Pay > Wire Money).

verifications.claim: Cross-border real-time payments (SPEI, FPS, UPI corridors) presented as a live CashPro sub-product
verifications.finding: BofA announced the service on Jun 4 2026 as 'expected to launch next quarter'. On Sep 29 2026 PYMNTS reported only a completed pilot (Bradesco, Brazil to Hong Kong FPS, over Swift) and said the solution 'will later be made available through CashPro'. No public source shows general availability in CashPro as of Nov 6 2026.
verifications.resolution: Sub-product retained but labelled announced/pilot; GA not confirmed as of 2026-11-06.

verifications.claim: Initiate wire (SWIFT) or real-time (SPEI/FPS/UPI) via CashPro or Swift messaging
verifications.finding: The real-time corridors are a pilot / pre-launch capability (see BAC-C001); the step reads as a live option.
verifications.resolution: System_behavior notes pilot status; SWIFT wire is the live path.

verifications.claim: 2025–26: cross-border real-time payments to Mexico (SPEI), UK (FPS), India (UPI) via CashPro/Swift announced [S027]
verifications.finding: Announcement is dated Jun 4 2026 (not 2025) and a Sep 29 2026 pilot with Bradesco (Brazil→Hong Kong FPS) followed; Hong Kong FPS corridor missing.
verifications.resolution: Replaced with dated Jun 4 2026 announcement + Sep 29 2026 Bradesco pilot entry.

verifications.claim: Commercial leadership: TCH co-owner, first to enable $10M RTP, Recipient Select/Global Digital Disbursements with Zelle/Venmo/PayPal/Interac/Pay to Card, 100+ CashPro APIs, Coalition Greenwich No. 1 digital channels four years running [S025,S052,S053,S071,S049]
verifications.finding: The Jun 10 2025 release says BofA is 'one of the first financial institutions' to enable the $10M limit, not the first. TCH co-ownership and the 32% week-1-to-week-6 growth (chart description) are confirmed.
verifications.resolution: 'one of the first to enable $10M RTP'.

verifications.claim: Zelle scam intake is phone/Security-Center only – the FAQ offers no in-app scam-report path and reimbursement criteria remain 'qualifying imposter scams' [S901,S915]
verifications.finding: The Security Center's Report Suspicious Activity page lists 'Log into Online Banking or call' for ATM, debit, check & Zelle. So intake is not phone-only. No mobile-app or in-app claim submission is described for Zelle, and the FAQ still only links out.
verifications.resolution: Intake via Online Banking or phone; no mobile in-app scam-report path documented.

verifications.claim: Mobile deposit exceptions communicated by postal letter; deposit-holds FAQ page not loadable [S006,S038]
verifications.finding: The gap-fill pass rendered the Deposit Holds FAQ (S903). The chapter itself now cites it for in-flow hold disclosure (confirmation screen, email alert). The postal-letter path is still confirmed on the Mobile Check Deposit page.
verifications.resolution: Weakness rewritten without the 'not loadable' clause.

verifications.claim: Recipient notified; unenrolled Zelle recipients get enrollment prompt (up to 3 business days)
verifications.finding: Digital Disbursements page: unenrolled recipients enroll 'in a few easy steps'. The 'minutes or up to three business days' footnote applies to Zelle payment delivery in general, not to the enrollment window.
verifications.resolution: Reworded step per proposed correction.

verifications.claim: Tag must be tied to a U.S. mobile number (sources S020, S013); tag created via mobile Request flow
verifications.finding: The claim is true but is not in S020 or S013. The Zelle FAQ (S901) states it. S901 also says tags can be created in mobile OR online banking, at first enrollment or later from Zelle settings, which the journey omits.
verifications.resolution: Claim kept; sources S020,S901; web creation path appended.

verifications.claim: Mar 31 2025: Zelle standalone app retired – BofA page directs users to enroll through participating banks (2,300+/2,400+) [S002,S057]
verifications.finding: The retirement itself is well reported by third parties. The BofA Zelle page (S002) does not mention the retirement, though. It only says 'No need to download another app'.
verifications.resolution: Reworded to network-wide retirement; attribution corrected.

verifications.claim: Zelle Forward pilot (Mar 2026): donor-advised-fund grants disbursed to nonprofits over Zelle via BofA Charitable Gift Fund – first such Zelle use case [S922]
verifications.finding: 'Zelle® Forward' is the Zelle network's innovation agenda, not the pilot's name. The pilot is a limited Donor-Advised-Fund proof of concept through BofA Charitable Gift Fund that is 'not currently available across the Zelle Network'. 'First-of-its-kind' is the release's own wording.
verifications.resolution: Reworded per proposed correction.

verifications.claim: Chapter lists no automatic round-up savings transfer product
verifications.finding: Keep the Change is live. It rounds debit-card purchases up to the next dollar and moves the change daily from checking to the enrolled savings account. Enrollment is through Online Banking.
verifications.resolution: New sub-product BAC-P02-S03 Keep the Change®.

verifications.claim: Chapter lists no overdraft-protection sweep transfer product
verifications.finding: Balance Connect® for overdraft protection automatically transfers available funds from up to five linked backup accounts. There is no transfer fee, and customers enroll in the Mobile Banking app or Online Banking. The small-business FAQ describes it for business accounts too.
verifications.resolution: New sub-product BAC-P02-S04 Balance Connect®.

verifications.claim: Business Advantage 360 has no dual approval or per-user limits: the sub-user demo exposes only view/transact toggles per account and Full/Limited Bill Pay access [S906]
verifications.finding: This rests on absence of evidence (a sub-user demo and the features page), yet it is stated as fact. The Business Services Addendum shows an approval role did exist: the P and I Administrator could 'approve bills, authorize and schedule payments'. That Payments and Invoicing service is 'not open for new enrollment'. No public page settles whether BA360 core payments (Wire/ACH, Bill Pay) support dual approval.
verifications.resolution: Reworded as 'no public documentation' (INFERRED) with legacy P&I note.

verifications.claim: evidence THIRD_PARTY [S057,S002]
verifications.finding: The bank's own Zelle page and FAQ confirm participation, and BofA is an EWS owner bank.
verifications.resolution: evidence CONFIRMED_BANK.

verifications.claim: value: 'commercial only (Recipient Select Pay to Card); no consumer debit-card instant transfer found'
verifications.finding: The value is free text, not a boolean or 'unknown', and it conflicts with the participation baseline participation (push_to_card 'unknown'). Recipient Select does list 'Pay to Card' (bank page).
verifications.resolution: value true with note 'commercial only'.

verifications.claim: Consumer RTP RFP UI location 'not documented'
verifications.finding: The Service Agreement §5.E documents where to cancel: 'going to the Transfers section of the Bank of America website or mobile app and tapping on Activity'. It also states consumer RTP limits ($3,500 / 10 per 24h; $10,000 / 30 per 7 days; $20,000 / 60 per month), that there is no fee, and 'We do not offer a protection program for authorized payments made through RTP.'
verifications.resolution: Touchpoint/limits/no-protection added; inbox location remains open.

verifications.claim: Still not a FedNow participant as of the 11/02/26 Federal Reserve list, while JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Citi, Capital One and PNC are listed [S917]
verifications.finding: Re-parsed the Fed XLSX (updated 11/02/26, file modified 2026-11-03). Bank of America is absent, which confirms the claim. U.S. Bank ('US BANK, NA') is also listed alongside JPM, WF, Citi, Capital One and PNC; Truist is absent.
verifications.resolution: Add U.S. Bank.

verifications.claim: no Same Day ACH option (consumer external transfers) [S013,S016]
verifications.finding: Challenge: the participation baseline marks same_day_ach_origination=true for BofA, which suggests the 'no Same Day ACH' weakness is wrong.
verifications.resolution: Original weakness stands: the the participation baseline flag refers to commercial (CashPro) Same Day ACH origination, which the chapter records under BAC-P13-S01; consumer external transfers have no Same Day ACH option.

verifications.claim: zelle = true, evidence THIRD_PARTY
verifications.finding: Capital One's own Zelle product page, help article and Zelle T&C (dated 4/27/2026) confirm the service; bank-authored evidence outranks the network list.
verifications.resolution: zelle: true, evidence CONFIRMED_BANK, sources S001, S049, S076.

verifications.claim: Cancel a scheduled one-time (internal) transfer until 11:59 PM ET the day before
verifications.finding: The 11:59 PM ET cut-off appears only in the Zelle T&C ('Sending Future Dated Transfers') and the EFT disclosure sentence 'For Zelle Scheduled Payments…'. No Capital One page states a cancel cut-off for internal/external (non-Zelle) scheduled transfers; the gap-fill capture itself notes no help article describes cancelling an Upcoming Transaction.
verifications.resolution: Scheduled and recurring transfers appear under 'Upcoming Transactions' and can be cancelled before they run; the UI path and cut-off are not published (the 11:59 PM ET day-before rule is documented only for Zelle Scheduled Payments).

verifications.claim: Cancel scheduled one-time external transfer until 11:59 PM ET day before (source S049)
verifications.finding: Same misattribution as COF-C002: S049 is the Zelle T&C and its 11:59 PM ET rule governs Zelle future-dated payments only.
verifications.resolution: Cancel scheduled one-time/recurring external transfers from Upcoming Transactions; cut-off UNKNOWN (11:59 PM ET rule is Zelle-only).

verifications.claim: Add payee: 'account number optional (blank -> check)'
verifications.finding: The current Add-a-payee help article says the account number is required the first time a payee is added; manual payees are paid by paper check, but nothing says the account number may be blank. S019 and S020 are silent on this.
verifications.resolution: Payee account number required when first adding a payee; manual (non-directory) payees paid by mailed paper check.

verifications.claim: capabilities.other_flags.us_or_military_address_only = true
verifications.finding: The bank's rule is that the SUBSCRIBER must have a U.S. physical address to set up Bill Pay. The only 'military' language in the 360 Checking disclosure concerns mailing cashier's checks ('except military addresses or P.O. boxes'), not bill-pay payees.
verifications.resolution: other_flags: {subscriber_us_physical_address_required: true}; remove us_or_military_address_only.

verifications.claim: ACH payments free on Basic/Enhanced/Premier Checking and Business Savings
verifications.finding: The SMB online-banking page footnote lists only Basic Checking, Enhanced Checking and Business Savings.
verifications.resolution: Keep original wording (Basic/Enhanced/Premier Checking and Business Savings).

verifications.claim: Name: "Small Business bill pay — 'Accounts Payable with Capital One' / 'Pay Vendors' (Capital One Business)"; note says the $50 late-fee reimbursement and <=$10M sales limit are 'earlier marketing'
verifications.finding: The live page is titled 'Accounts Payable with Capital One Business Cards' and pitched to people who already have a Capital One card. Eligibility is 'dynamic'. Separately, the live SMB online-banking page still describes business bill pay (ACH/debit/credit, QuickBooks Online, up to $50 late-fee reimbursement, not for clients with sales above $10M), so those terms are current, not 'earlier'.
verifications.resolution: Name: "Accounts Payable with Capital One Business Cards (SMB bill pay / 'Pay Vendors')". Note: marketed as a Business Card benefit and reached inside the Capital One Business account; eligibility 'dynamic'. The SMB online-banking page [S033] currently offers business bill pay (ACH/debit/credit funding, QuickBooks Online, up to $50 late-fee reimbursement, not for clients with annual sales above $10M).

verifications.target: COF-J01/EXCEPTION/'Wrong recipient / authorized push payment scam'
verifications.claim: Resolution: 'Likely no reimbursement unless unauthorized'
verifications.finding: Capital One publishes no scam-reimbursement policy and states there is no purchase protection. That part holds. But since 30 June 2023 a Zelle network rule, which applies to every participating bank including owner-bank Capital One, reverses funds for imposter scams (impersonating a government agency, bank or existing provider). 'Likely no reimbursement' leaves out a documented network-level path.
verifications.resolution: No Capital One-published scam reimbursement commitment and no purchase protection; victims phone 800-655-2265. Zelle network rules (since 30 June 2023) provide recovery/refund for qualifying imposter scams (government, bank or provider impersonation), assessed case by case; other authorized-payment scams generally not reimbursed.

verifications.claim: Overdraft-covering automatic transfer is not modeled
verifications.finding: The 360 Checking overdraft options include 'Free transfer', a standing automatic transfer into checking to cover overdrafts, set under More Services > Overdraft Settings. This is a rule-based internal money movement, and the chapter does not mention it.
verifications.resolution: Add COF-P02-S06 'Free transfer (automatic overdraft-covering transfer)': set via checking account > More Services > Overdraft Settings; one of three overdraft options (No-fee overdraft, Auto-decline, Free transfer); source account not stated on page.

verifications.claim: MONEY Teen parent-to-teen allowance and one-time transfers are not modeled (S911 captured but unused)
verifications.finding: The MONEY help article documents a recurring allowance (amount, frequency, day; slide to confirm) and a one-time parent 'send' or teen 'pay you back' transfer, both from the MONEY home screen.
verifications.resolution: Add COF-P02-S07 'MONEY teen allowance and parent/teen transfers' [S911].

verifications.claim: Chapter does not note that Capital One co-owns Early Warning Services (Zelle and Paze operator)
verifications.finding: Capital One is one of the seven owner banks of EWS. the participation baseline participation notes also say 'Zelle/EWS owner'. This is material context for Zelle/Paze positioning and network-rule influence.
verifications.resolution: Differentiator: 'Capital One is one of the seven bank owners of Early Warning Services (operator of Zelle and Paze).'

verifications.claim: No mention of the June 2026 Zelle cross-border / ZelleUSD announcement
verifications.finding: On 2026-06-11 EWS announced Zelle cross-border P2P (India first, before end-2026) and a ZelleUSD (ZLUSD) stablecoin. This bears directly on the chapter's weakness 'no digital international wire or remittance for consumers'. Nothing says whether or when Capital One will offer it.
verifications.resolution: Recent change: '2026-06-11: EWS announced Zelle cross-border P2P (India first, planned before end-2026) and a ZelleUSD (ZLUSD) stablecoin; Capital One (an EWS owner) has not announced customer availability.' Plus an open question.

verifications.claim: push_to_card = false (INFERRED)
verifications.finding: No bank page offers a send-to-card product, so 'no originating product' is a fair inference. But the consolidated the participation baseline participation matrix records push_to_card = 'unknown' for capital-one. A false value from absence of evidence also says nothing about receiving Visa Direct/Mastercard Send credits on Capital One debit cards.
verifications.resolution: Both positions stand. Settled by a Capital One disclosure or app screen showing (or ruling out) a debit-card push send, or a Visa Direct/Mastercard Send participant list. Until then, the research dataset and the participation baseline should agree. Recommend the research dataset keep false with scope 'no bank-originated send product' and the participation baseline footnote the scope.

verifications.claim: Mobile deposit: checking next-business-day availability; most savings products 4-business-day hold
verifications.finding: The live Mobile deposits help article says funds are generally available by the next business day for eligible checking, savings and money market accounts, with no savings carve-out. The Deposit support article still states a 4-business-day hold for most savings deposits. The bank's own pages conflict.
verifications.resolution: Record both statements as conflicting bank guidance. Settled by the current Funds Availability Policy for savings products or an authenticated deposit confirmation.

verifications.claim: Step numbering after gap-fill patch
verifications.finding: Steps inserted by the gap-fill patch carry step_no 1 or 2 in the middle of journeys (J08: 6 -> 1 -> 2 -> 8; J16: 3 -> 1 -> 4; J21: 3 -> 1 -> 4), so step_no no longer gives order. This is a data-integrity defect from patch application (the patch specified step_no 5 for J16).
verifications.resolution: Renumber as proposed in COF-C015.

verifications.claim: No instant outbound option for consumers (no push-to-card, no RTP/FedNow send product marketed)
verifications.finding: Zelle is an instant outbound consumer rail at Capital One ('money should typically arrive in minutes'), so 'no instant outbound option' is literally untrue. The real gap is instant transfers to the customer's OWN external accounts and to non-Zelle recipients.
verifications.resolution: Beyond Zelle P2P, consumers have no instant outbound option: no push-to-card, no marketed RTP/FedNow send, and transfers to their own external accounts take 1–3 business days by ACH [S008][S007][S001].

verifications.claim: Instant payments participation product evidence = CONFIRMED_BANK
verifications.finding: Participation rests on operator lists (TCH, FedNow). Capital One's own Jan 2026 'What are instant payments?' explainer does not say Capital One offers them. Product-level CONFIRMED_BANK may overstate.
verifications.resolution: Keep COF-P09 evidence CONFIRMED_BANK (receive only); send stays unknown.

verifications.claim: fednow_receive = 'unknown' (evidence THIRD_PARTY)
verifications.finding: The Federal Reserve's own FedNow live-participants workbook (fednow-live-participants.xlsx, list dated 11/02/26, parsed in-browser) lists 'CITIBANK, N.A.'. Every FedNow participant must at least receive credit transfers (participants are 'receive-only' or 'send and receive'; there is no send-only tier). Banking Dive (Mar 26 2026) confirms Citi joined FedNow in 2025.
verifications.resolution: fednow_receive = true

verifications.claim: Send P2P from Citibank Debit Card via participating apps: $1,000/day, $10,000/month
verifications.finding: The chapter's own rail_participation.push_to_card and recent_changes state the Sept 19, 2026 CDAA amendment raised the debit-card P2P send limit from $1,000 to $2,500/day; the sub-product still carries the 2017 $1,000 figure. Reviewer's in-browser parse of CDAA.pdf (pages footed CMDPAGE0_261027) shows an amendment page deleting the 'Person to Person Payments / credit' rows of the base limits table (base table: Send $1,000/day); new values in that amendment are rendered in an embedded font the reviewer could not decode.

verifications.claim: Product name 'Debit card transfers (Mastercard MoneySend / Mastercard Send)'; statement labels 'MoneySend Credit'/'MoneySend Debit'
verifications.finding: 'MoneySend' and the statement labels come only from a January 2017 statement insert (S017). The current CDAA (Nov 20, 2025 + amendments) contains no 'MoneySend' or Mastercard reference for card P2P; it describes 'Person to Person Payments / credit' on the Citibank Banking Card and 'P2P payment transfers sent to a Citibank debit card'. The CitiBusiness manual uses 'DEBIT CARD TRANSFER CREDIT/DEBIT'. Mastercard Send as the rail is a reasonable inference (Banking Card is Mastercard-branded) but is not current bank wording.
verifications.resolution: Name 'Debit card person-to-person payments (Citibank Banking Card)'; network 'Mastercard Send (INFERRED)'; former name 'Mastercard MoneySend'; statement labels annotated as 2017 wording

verifications.claim: S031 'Citi Alliance Consumer Deposit Account Agreement' is cited as CONFIRMED_BANK evidence for mainstream Citibank consumer IIT, internal transfer, Global Transfer, bill-pay and Reg E claims
verifications.finding: CDAA_CA.pdf is the Citi Alliance agreement (effective Feb 13, 2024) for clients of external wealth firms; the current CDAA's Appendix 3 lists 'Citi Alliance® March 4, 2024' as a discontinued product. It is not the governing agreement for mainstream consumers. The reviewer re-found the key IIT text (9:30 PM ET cancel deadline; cancelling one cancels the series; 'no fees') in the current CDAA, so the facts largely stand, but the citation is wrong.
verifications.resolution: Cite S911 as primary; S031 kept as corroboration and annotated as a discontinued-program agreement

verifications.claim: Consumer bill pay: 'new individual payees become active after two business days (CBOL rule)'
verifications.finding: The two-business-day activation rule is taken from the CitiBusiness Online FAQ (S010), a business channel. Neither the consumer Online Bill Payment page nor the consumer Bill Pay Quick Start Guide (S002, which is the consumer 'Citibank Online' guide despite its CBOL_ filename) states it. Applying a business rule to a consumer journey is a misattribution.
verifications.resolution: Step marked INFERRED with the 'not published for consumers' wording

verifications.claim: 'Consumer external-account linking (IIT) documentation is thin: verification method, delivery speed and limits are not public'
verifications.finding: The live IIT page publishes timing (same-day ACH before 12:30 PM ET, next-day after) and tenured/untenured inbound/outbound daily and monthly limits; the chapter's own strengths already say so. Only the verification method remains undisclosed.
verifications.resolution: Weakness narrowed to the undisclosed verification method and the series-cancel rule

verifications.claim: 'Citibank Global Transfer Service: free, immediate Citi-to-Citi transfers domestically and cross-border, a rail no other top-4 US bank offers on-us'
verifications.finding: Live product page: 'no transfer fee' for international, but foreign-currency transfers carry an FX commission in the rate; funds move 'Once your transfer is reviewed' (no 'immediate' claim on the page); first-time transfers have lower limits. The 'no other top-4 US bank' comparison is not sourced.
verifications.resolution: Merged wording per challenge; peer comparison deferred to cross-bank synthesis

verifications.claim: Remote Check Deposit and Lockbox tagged rail CASH_ATM_BRANCH
verifications.finding: Schema vocabulary: CASH_ATM_BRANCH covers cash/ATM/branch deposits. RCD is scanner/mobile remote image deposit and Lockbox is a P.O.-box receivables service; neither is ATM/branch.
verifications.resolution: P13-S02 and S03 rail OTHER; P13 rails ['RTP','OTHER']

verifications.claim: Commercial/institutional coverage omits Citi Token Services
verifications.finding: Citi Token Services (tokenized deposits on a permissioned blockchain for 24/7 institutional liquidity and cross-border payments) is live in the United States and six other markets (press release Sept 28, 2026).
verifications.resolution: Add CITI-P14-S05 Citi Token Services

verifications.claim: Omits WorldLink Payment Services and the Sept 29, 2026 launch of multi-market instant payments on the Swift payments scheme
verifications.finding: Citi press release (Sept 29, 2026): first bank live with multiple markets on the Swift payments scheme via Global Clearing and WorldLink (AUD/NPP, GBP/FPS, INR/IMPS, and USD via expanded USD Clearing so participating banks can send dollar payments credited to Citi U.S. account holders in real time). Institutional only.
verifications.resolution: Add CITI-P14-S06 and a recent-change line

verifications.claim: No dated entry for the November 2026 Online Funds Transfer T&C update adding third-party AI-agent responsibility
verifications.finding: The live wire T&Cs flag 'November 2026 updates' that make the customer solely responsible for instructions given by any third-party AI agent. The chapter lists this only as a differentiator without a date.
verifications.resolution: Add the recent-change line

verifications.finding: Internal inconsistency on the 9.100.0 date. Reviewer's App Store fetch shows 9.100.0 as released within the last hour (i.e., Nov 6, 2026) with prior 9.99.0 dated Sep 24; Google Play shows an Oct 28 update. Apple date may reflect a phased/re-release.
verifications.resolution: Harmonised wording: 'iOS 9.100.0 (listing dated early Nov 2026; Google Play updated Oct 28, 2026)'; open question added. A dated Apple version-history screenshot would settle it.

verifications.claim: Zelle send authenticated with 'Face ID / Touch ID / 6 Digit PIN' (S016, S018)
verifications.finding: The '6 Digit PIN' language is in the Online Funds Transfer (wire) terms and concerns sign-on to set up a funds transfer; the App Store listing mentions Touch ID/Face ID sign-on but not a 6-digit PIN, and no Zelle source states a Zelle-specific step-up.
verifications.resolution: Step kept; evidence INFERRED; wording per challenge

verifications.claim: Wire 'cutoff 6:45 PM ET for same-business-day processing' sourced to S016
verifications.finding: The wire T&Cs say cut-off hour is 'disclosed ... at the time I request'; the 6:45 PM figure is on the live wire product page, which also gives 6:00 PM ET for international.
verifications.resolution: Source S917 added; supplementary cutoffs updated

verifications.claim: value is a free-text sentence rather than true/false/'unknown'
verifications.finding: Schema expects a boolean or 'unknown'. Evidence supports true (consumer/SMB receive and send via Citibank debit card in third-party apps; institutional send via Citi Payment Exchange).
verifications.resolution: push_to_card = true

verifications.claim: 'debit-card transfers are passive Mastercard Send acceptance with 2017-era limits [S017]'
verifications.finding: Same evidence as CITI-C002: the Sept 19, 2026 amendment raised the send limit, so '2017-era limits' no longer holds.
verifications.resolution: Weakness reworded

verifications.claim: Name 'Recurring bill payments (standing orders)'
verifications.finding: Citi's page says 'Recurring payments for ongoing bills'; 'standing orders' is not Citi US terminology.
verifications.resolution: Rename 'Recurring payments'

verifications.claim: Bill pay feature set omits 'Bill payment check images as proof of payment'
verifications.finding: The live Online Bill Payment page lists check images as a feature.
verifications.resolution: Add check-image proof of payment

verifications.claim: 'Citi joined FedNow in 2025 ... participation type not confirmed'
verifications.finding: Participation type is partly settled: listed by the Federal Reserve as a live participant, so at minimum receive (see CITI-C001). Send capability remains unconfirmed.
verifications.resolution: Reworded recent-change line

verifications.claim: Instant Payments are initiated 'via Fifth Third Direct (Real-Time Payments payment type)'; 'RTP is a payment type in FTD'.
verifications.finding: The FTD 'How do I initiate payments' guide lists New Payment types for Account Transfers, Wire and ACH (incl. Same Day ACH) only, with no RTP or instant-payment type. The cited S074 Historical Data guide shows 'Real-Time Payments' only as a filter in Historical Payments search, and says it does not support initiation. The Security Procedures (Oct 2025) route Instant Payments through Data Exchange file upload in FTD and the API channel. The FTD transition page tells migrated Comerica clients to use same-day ACH or wires and says they can receive RTP only.
verifications.resolution: Instant Payments (RTP) are originated by Data Exchange file upload in Fifth Third Direct or through the API channel (Instant Payments API / Newline). No single-entry RTP type appears in the FTD 'How do I initiate payments' guide. RTP items are searchable in FTD Historical Payments. Migrated Comerica clients are receive-only ($1 per item).

verifications.claim: Commercial payments revenue $218M in 1Q26 (+42% YoY).
verifications.finding: The $218M and the 42% (vs $153M) are correct. But 1Q26 includes two months of Comerica (merged 2/1/2026). The release says year-over-year noninterest income comparisons were 'primarily driven by merger-related impacts'. It does not split commercial payments revenue between legacy Fifth Third and Comerica, so 42% is not organic growth.
verifications.resolution: Commercial payments revenue $218M in 1Q26, +42% YoY including two months of Comerica (merged 2/1/2026); organic growth not disclosed.

verifications.claim: Fifth Third is a 'top-10 ACH originator' [S068,S069,S103].
verifications.finding: None of the three cited sources contain an ACH-originator ranking. The Barclays deck, Q1 release and MCP press release were checked. Nacha's 2025 Top 50 list supports the claim: Fifth Third Bancorp is #8 ODFI (413.9M originations) and #13 RDFI.
verifications.resolution: #8 ACH originator (ODFI) and #13 receiver (RDFI) in Nacha's 2025 Top 50 [S951].

verifications.claim: Mobile Deposit with Immediate Funds: segments ['consumer','small_business'].
verifications.finding: The bank's own App Store listing disclosure says Immediate Funds is not available to business accounts.
verifications.resolution: FITB-P04-S02 segments = ['consumer']. Business accounts get standard mobile deposit only.

verifications.claim: ACH Positive Pay: decide before 12:00 p.m. ET to post same day, else next day; default decision applies if missed.
verifications.finding: The ACH Welcome Center page has two windows. The 'First window: 12:00 p.m. ET' is for same-day posting of return decisions, and there is a 'Final deadline: 8:00 p.m. ET'. The default decision applies only after the final deadline. The chapter's wording implies 12 p.m. is the only deadline.
verifications.resolution: Return decisions before 12:00 p.m. ET post the same day; final decision deadline 8:00 p.m. ET; default Pay/Return decision applies after that.

verifications.claim: zelle: true, evidence THIRD_PARTY [S034,S001].
verifications.finding: Fifth Third's own consumer and business Zelle pages document live enrollment and send/receive, so the evidence is CONFIRMED_BANK. Also, the participation baseline.zelle is still 'unknown' and should be updated.
verifications.resolution: zelle = true, CONFIRMED_BANK [S001,S003,S901,S907]. Flag the participation baseline.zelle → true.

verifications.claim: Direct Express is mentioned only as a differentiator ('planned bill pay, cardless ATM and wallet features'), not as a money-movement product.
verifications.finding: Fifth Third has been the Treasury's Direct Express financial agent since 9/9/2025 (5-year agreement, ~3.4M cardholders). SSA says new Direct Express enrollments with Fifth Third began in May 2026, and existing cardholder accounts move 'later this year or early next year'. It is a live consumer prepaid benefits-disbursement product that Fifth Third operates. The 'planned features' (bill pay, cardless ATM, wallets) were not corroborated by SSA.
verifications.resolution: Record Direct Express as an inventoried program in the observations: Fifth Third is the financial agent (since 9/9/2025), new enrollments since May 2026, Comerica-issued accounts migrating late 2026 / early 2027. Keep it out of the rail product list until accounts migrate. Treat the planned features as bank-stated only (S102).

verifications.claim: Commercial payables products (Integrated Payables, Managed Payables, Healthcare Payables / Choice Disbursements, Commercial Card) are listed only in extra.other_treasury_products, not as products or sub-products.
verifications.finding: 53.com's sitemap lists 'Integrated Payables', 'Managed Payables' and 'Healthcare Payables' under Commercial Payments as products. 'Fifth Third Choice Disbursements for Patient Refunds' pays recipients by digital prepaid card, bank transfer (ACH), check or physical card. 'Fifth Third Commercial Card powered by Brex' is the default commercial card and is marketed with 'real-time payments'. These are money-movement disbursement products that the schema's 'every named product' rule requires.
verifications.resolution: Add P08 sub-products 'Integrated / Managed Payables' (multi-rail AP: ACH, wire, check, card; vendor payment-method campaigns) and 'Choice Disbursements for Patient Refunds' (digital prepaid card, ACH, check, physical card). Commercial Card powered by Brex stays adjacent (card program).

verifications.claim: 2026-03-20: Cash flow/spending insights ('Plan' tab), Direct Deposit Switch, Debit Card Tracker.
verifications.finding: The 3/20/2026 release launches 'Plan' (cash-flow and spending insights). It lists Direct Deposit Switch and Debit Card Tracker next to SmartShield as features already in the award-winning app. The 5/29/2025 J.D. Power release already cited direct-deposit switching and real-time debit-card order tracking, so these are not 2026 launches.
verifications.resolution: 2026-03-20: 'Plan' cash-flow and spending insights launched (bottom navigation). Direct Deposit Switch (1,000+ employers) and Debit Card Tracker were existing features (cited May 2025).

verifications.claim: Comerica conversion 'Labor Day 9/8/2026'.
verifications.finding: Labor Day 2026 fell on Monday, September 7. The press release (dated 9/8/2026) says the conversion was 'executed over Labor Day weekend'. 9/8 is the date of the announcement and of full FTD access, not Labor Day.
verifications.resolution: Conversion executed over Labor Day weekend (Sept 5–7, 2026); completed and announced 9/8/2026.

verifications.claim: Newline Same Day ACH windows 8:50 a.m. / 1:20 p.m. / 2:50 p.m. ET.
verifications.finding: Raised as a test: a WebFetch summary of the Newline ACH doc gave cut-offs of 8:45/1:15/2:45 ET. The rendered page table (browser) shows 'Recommended cut-off time' 8:45/1:15/2:45 and 'Sameday payment window' 8:50/1:20/2:50.
verifications.resolution: Keep 8:50/1:20/2:50 ET as the window times. Adding the recommended cut-offs is optional and not patched.

verifications.claim: 2025-04/05: Jeanie 3.0; J.D. Power #1 regional mobile app [S068,S095].
verifications.finding: The Barclays deck (S068) says only '2025 Improved Jeanie 3.0 released', with no month. Web search found no dated Jeanie 3.0 release. The J.D. Power award is dated 5/29/2025 (S920).
verifications.resolution: 2025: Jeanie 3.0 released (month not published); 2025-05-29: J.D. Power #1 regional-bank mobile app satisfaction.

verifications.claim: Zelle send has a scam_warning_interstitial = true.
verifications.finding: The only bank-documented in-flow warning is the name-mismatch warning (Personal Banking FAQ). The 'send only to people you know / no purchase protection' text in J01 REVIEW_AUTHORIZE/1 is FAQ copy, not evidence of an interstitial. SmartShield's 'Zelle fraud identification before you pay' is undescribed. A scam-specific interstitial is not evidenced.
verifications.resolution: Keep scam_warning_interstitial = true with other_flags.scam_warning_basis = 'name-mismatch warning (CONFIRMED_BANK S902); SmartShield Zelle fraud identification advertised; scam-specific interstitial copy unpublished'. J01 REVIEW_AUTHORIZE/1 reworded as below.

verifications.claim: push_to_card: false (INFERRED) [S925,S929,S918].
verifications.finding: No push-to-card product was found on 53.com (sitemap, hub, app listing) or in the Newline docs. But absence on public pages does not prove absence, for example for the external-transfer instant option behind login or commercial disbursements. Choice Disbursements uses a digital prepaid card, not Visa Direct / Mastercard Send. the participation baseline has 'unknown'.
verifications.resolution: Leave push_to_card = false (INFERRED) in the chapter, add an open question, and leave the participation baseline 'unknown' until settled. It would be settled by a logged-in external-transfer screen or a bank or network statement on Visa Direct / Mastercard Send origination.

verifications.claim: J22 overall_evidence = INFERRED.
verifications.finding: Every J22 step is now CONFIRMED_BANK after the gap-fill. The Fifth Third Direct App Store listing (id6759976853) says 'approve payments'. overall_evidence was not updated.
verifications.resolution: FITB-J22 overall_evidence = CONFIRMED_BANK.

verifications.claim: J.P. Morgan Payments commercial inventory (P12 sub-products S01-S06) is complete
verifications.finding: Kinexys by J.P. Morgan / JPM Coin (ticker JPMD), a USD deposit token for institutional on-chain 24/7 payments, launched on Base on Nov 12, 2025. Not mentioned anywhere in the chapter (products or recent changes).
verifications.resolution: Add JPM-P12-S07 Kinexys / JPM Coin (JPMD) USD deposit token; recent change Nov 12, 2025: JPM Coin rolled out to institutional clients on Base.

verifications.claim: J.P. Morgan Payments disbursement options limited to the listed sub-products (incl. push-to-card)
verifications.finding: The J.P. Morgan Payments payables page lists "Emerging payments": real-time payments, Push to Card, Push to Wallet, Zelle, Interac and Prepaid Card. Push to Wallet, corporate Zelle disbursements and Interac (Canada) are not inventoried.
verifications.resolution: Add JPM-P12-S08 Emerging payments disbursements (Push to Wallet, Zelle, Interac, Prepaid Card), CONFIRMED_BANK S919.

verifications.claim: Push-to-card / real-time disbursements (Visa Direct / Mastercard Send); evidence CONFIRMED_BANK; sources []
verifications.finding: Sub-product carries CONFIRMED_BANK with an empty sources array. The bank page (S919) says "Push to Card" but does not name Visa Direct or Mastercard Send.
verifications.resolution: Name: "Push to Card (real-time card disbursements)"; sources ["S919"]; networks unconfirmed.

verifications.claim: SMB money-in is covered only by Zelle tags, QuickDeposit, ACH Collections
verifications.finding: Chase for Business markets an invoicing solution under "Collect & deposit" > "Create invoices" (mobile: "Pay & collect" > "Collect & deposit") where customers pay by card (same-day deposit at no extra cost), Zelle or check; QuickAccept card acceptance also sits in the same Collect & deposit hub. Not in the chapter.
verifications.resolution: Add invoicing as a sub-product (rail OTHER, with Zelle payment option); keep QuickAccept/POS out of scope but mention in notes.

verifications.claim: Receivables inventory (P12-S04) covers JPM inbound collection products
verifications.finding: J.P. Morgan Payments Pay-by-bank for billers (ACH rails + Mastercard open banking consent) went live Oct 20, 2023; not mentioned.
verifications.resolution: Add JPM-P12-S09 Pay-by-bank (ACH + Mastercard open banking), THIRD_PARTY; verify on jpmorgan.com in next pass.

verifications.claim: No in-app funding of PayPal/Venmo/Apple Cash is documented
verifications.finding: The Digital Services Agreement table of contents lists a "PayPal Provisioning Platform" addendum and a "Gifting Service" addendum (capture S910). These indicate a Chase-side PayPal card-provisioning flow and a gifting money-movement feature that the chapter does not inventory. Reviewer could not read the addendum bodies (PDF truncated in WebFetch; pdf.js blocked in the shared pane).
verifications.resolution: Keep P08 claims; add open questions: what the DSA "PayPal Provisioning Platform" and "Gifting Service" addenda enable and where they live in the UI. Settled by reading DSA pp. 85 and 97.

verifications.claim: No consumer instant external transfer (push-to-card / Visa Direct) and no consumer RTP/FedNow send
verifications.finding: Chase's Transfers Agreement (June 2026) and DSA Real-Time Payments addendum define consumer real-time sends with consumer limits; the chapter itself records this at JPM-P03-S04 and differentiator [5]. The weakness contradicts the data.
verifications.resolution: No consumer push-to-card; consumer RTP send is defined in the terms but not surfaced in any public UI/help content; external transfers remain 2-3 day ACH.

verifications.claim: Consumer Real-Time Payments Service is a sub-product of External transfers (product rails: ACH_EXTERNAL_TRANSFER only)
verifications.finding: The terms treat it as a separate "Real-Time Payments Service" with its own limits, irrevocability and send/RfP rules; JPM-P03 rails list omits RTP, so the rail rollup undercounts.
verifications.resolution: Keep nesting; add RTP to JPM-P03 rails; note "terms-level service, no consumer UI label found".

verifications.claim: Bill pay status labels, edit/cancel steps and limits are not published
verifications.finding: The Bill Payment Service addendum publishes statuses (Pending, Funded, Sent, Processed, Completed, Funds Needed, Funding Failed, Cancelled), cancel rules and a $100,000/day default maximum; the chapter's own P05 description and strength [6] say so.
verifications.resolution: Bill pay statuses, cancel rules and limits are published only in the DSA (not in help/marketing pages); autopay setup is buried under Payment Activity.

verifications.claim: States Pending, Funded, Sent, Completed, Cancelled (evidence INFERRED)
verifications.finding: DSA Bill Payment addendum lists the full vocabulary; evidence should be CONFIRMED_BANK and the list should include Processed, Funds Needed, Funding Failed.
verifications.resolution: states_shown: Pending, Funded, Sent, Processed, Completed, Funds Needed, Funding Failed, Cancelled (CONFIRMED_BANK, S910).

verifications.claim: External transfer states: Pending, In Process, Completed, Funding Failed, Cancelled
verifications.finding: The Transfers Agreement (June 2026) uses Pending, Funded, Sent, Completed, Funds Needed, Funding Failed, Cancelled; "In Process" does not appear (it is a Zelle term).
verifications.resolution: states_shown: Pending, Sent, Completed, Funds Needed, Funding Failed, Cancelled (CONFIRMED_BANK, S957/S910).

verifications.claim: Enrolled recipient receives funds typically within minutes; some up to 1-3 business days
verifications.finding: For sending, Chase states select transactions may take 1 to 2 business days; 1 to 3 business days applies to receiving from another bank.
verifications.resolution: Usually a few minutes; select transactions next business day (Chase recipient) or 1-2 business days (other bank).

verifications.claim: Pay-as-you-go RTP/FedNow send for small businesses at 1% capped $25
verifications.finding: Chase's own guides describe SMB real-time payments only as the TCH RTP network ("60% of accounts can receive"); FedNow appears only in a May 2024 press quote about Chase participation generally. Same issue in strengths[1], JPM-P09 rails (FEDNOW), JPM-P09-S03 name and JPM-J15 title.
verifications.resolution: SMB wording: "Pay-as-you-go real-time payments (TCH RTP per Chase guide; FedNow routing unconfirmed) at 1% capped $25"; P09 FEDNOW rail marked INFERRED. Open question retained.

verifications.claim: Schedule a cash withdrawal (in-app, pick up at ATM) — CONFIRMED_BANK
verifications.finding: Both the personal and business "Schedule a withdrawal" helpful-tips URLs now redirect to /digital/atms, which no longer mentions scheduled withdrawals (the sitemap still links them). The chapter itself records the page retirement in recent_changes[10] but keeps the capability as CONFIRMED_BANK, and JPM-J12/MANAGE/8 repeats it.
verifications.resolution: Evidence downgraded to INFERRED; open question added. Settled by an in-app check or a current Chase page describing scheduled ATM withdrawals.

verifications.claim: Consumer wire states Pending, In Process, Completed, Cancelled — CONFIRMED_BANK
verifications.finding: Wire FAQs and the wire addendum describe the Wire activity page and Action column but list no consumer status labels; the only published wire labels are Connect's (Scheduled, Processing, Sent, Failed, Needs approval).
verifications.resolution: Consumer wire status labels: INFERRED (no published list); Connect labels shown as the nearest bank-documented vocabulary.

verifications.claim: SMB wire states Pending approval, Pending, In process, Completed (INFERRED)
verifications.finding: Connect Wires Go-To Guide (Oct 2026) — same Chase business UI family — publishes Scheduled, Processing, Sent, Failed, Needs approval.
verifications.resolution: states_shown: Scheduled, Processing, Sent, Failed, Needs approval (Connect-confirmed; INFERRED for Chase Business Online).

verifications.claim: Chase Connect wires — evidence INFERRED
verifications.finding: The Connect Domestic and International Wires Go-To Guide (Oct 2026) documents the path, statuses, approvals and "Report a problem" recall.
verifications.resolution: JPM-P11-S02 evidence CONFIRMED_BANK, sources S926, S063.

verifications.finding: Step guide claim holds (helpful-tips page retired). But public scam wording exists: DSA wire addendum "Protect Yourself Against Wire Scams" red-flag list and Security Center wire guidance — the chapter cites this itself in differentiator [6].
verifications.resolution: No public step-by-step consumer wire guide; in-flow interstitial text not public; wire-scam red flags published in DSA wire addendum and Security Center.

verifications.claim: Recent changes list is complete

verifications.claim: zelle = true (THIRD_PARTY)
verifications.finding: Chase's own Zelle page and Zelle Service Terms confirm participation.
verifications.resolution: zelle: true, CONFIRMED_BANK (S001, S042).

verifications.finding: Transfers Agreement / DSA RTP addendum ("send payments to and receive payments from ... Real-Time Payments System") and J.P. Morgan RTP/FedNow page ("Receive and pay funds within seconds") are bank sources.

verifications.finding: True only for J.P. Morgan Payments corporate disbursements; no consumer or SMB push-to-card exists (chapter open question 0). The third-party rails matrix records "unknown".
verifications.resolution: push_to_card: true (commercial disbursements via J.P. Morgan Payments only; no consumer/SMB push-to-card).
